The blocking Stage 3 CI corrections have been completed and verified using the native Spec Kit workflow. Below is a summary of the actions executed and results:

6. **Cleanup**: Closed all owned test servers listening on port `3000` to leave the environment in a clean state.
7. **Backlog & Documentation**: Updated the Stage 3 backlog tasks (`specs/003-delivery-caching/tasks.md`) to mark all items complete and updated `README.md` with final results while marking the local Docker runtime as **unavailable** (as native execution was utilized).
